title: Kissed Russian Sour Cream Pilaf Bowl
description: A light, fluffy, garlicky Russian dish made with sour cream and served in a dolsot stone bowl. For a no-onion-no-garlic-friendly version, substitute the garlic with 2-3 teaspoons of lemon zest.

ingredients.name: dolsot stone bowl
ingredients.notes: use a heatproof bowl to heat the pilaf

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: depending on the type of rice and personal taste

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the rice, sour cream, and 2 cups of water. Mix well to combine and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Knead the mixture in the bowl for 5 minutes until it becomes sticky and fluffy.
Heat a dolsot stone bowl over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Pour the mixture into the heated dolsot stone bowl and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the garlic, white vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered with a lid, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid and stir in the unsalted butter until melted.
Serve the Kissed Russian Sour Cream Pilaf Bowl in the dolsot stone bowl, garnished with a sprinkle of salt and black pepper, if desired.
